_comment: jscpd - the duplication REPORT (npm run check:dup). Never a gate: no `threshold` key, so it always exits 0; the console summary and audit-reports/jscpd/jscpd-report.json (gitignored) feed docs/CODE-QUALITY-LEDGER.md. maxSize/maxLines are raised on purpose - the defaults (100kb / 1000 lines) silently skip public/js/assets.js, integrations.js and src/services/monitoringService.ts, which are most of what the report is for.
